name: Pixel Matrix Display
description: A glowing dot-matrix display that dissolves between a marquee, a live clock, an equaliser, a heartbeat trace and an orbit loader. Canvas, zero deps.

props.name: text
props.description: Marquee text. A–Z, 0–9 and : . - / % + render; trailing spaces add a gap.

props.name: color
props.description: Lit dot colour; also tints the bloom.

props.name: chrome
props.description: Show the scene caption and prev/pause/next controls.
